1 #===============================================================================
    2 # Shows the battle scene fading in while elements slide around into place
    3 #===============================================================================
    4 class Battle::Scene::Animation::Intro < Battle::Scene::Animation
    5   def initialize(sprites, viewport, battle)
    6     @battle = battle
    7     super(sprites, viewport)
    8   end
    9 
   10   def createProcesses
   11     appearTime = 20   # This is in 1/20 seconds
   12     # Background
   13     if @sprites["battle_bg2"]
   14       makeSlideSprite("battle_bg", 0.5, appearTime)
   15       makeSlideSprite("battle_bg2", 0.5, appearTime)
   16     end
   17     # Bases
   18     makeSlideSprite("base_0", 1, appearTime, PictureOrigin::BOTTOM)
   19     makeSlideSprite("base_1", -1, appearTime, PictureOrigin::CENTER)
   20     # Player sprite, partner trainer sprite
   21     @battle.player.each_with_index do |_p, i|
   22       makeSlideSprite("player_#{i + 1}", 1, appearTime, PictureOrigin::BOTTOM)
   23     end
   24     # Opposing trainer sprite(s) or wild Pokémon sprite(s)
   25     if @battle.trainerBattle?
   26       @battle.opponent.each_with_index do |_p, i|
   27         makeSlideSprite("trainer_#{i + 1}", -1, appearTime, PictureOrigin::BOTTOM)
   28       end
   29     else   # Wild battle
   30       @battle.pbParty(1).each_with_index do |_pkmn, i|
   31         idxBattler = (2 * i) + 1
   32         makeSlideSprite("pokemon_#{idxBattler}", -1, appearTime, PictureOrigin::BOTTOM)
   33       end
   34     end
   35     # Shadows
   36     @battle.battlers.length.times do |i|
   37       makeSlideSprite("shadow_#{i}", (i.even?) ? 1 : -1, appearTime, PictureOrigin::CENTER)
   38     end
   39     # Fading blackness over whole screen
   40     blackScreen = addNewSprite(0, 0, "Graphics/Battle animations/black_screen")
   41     blackScreen.setZ(0, 999)
   42     blackScreen.moveOpacity(0, 8, 0)
   43     # Fading blackness over command bar
   44     blackBar = addNewSprite(@sprites["cmdBar_bg"].x, @sprites["cmdBar_bg"].y,
   45                             "Graphics/Battle animations/black_bar")
   46     blackBar.setZ(0, 998)
   47     blackBar.moveOpacity(appearTime * 3 / 4, appearTime / 4, 0)
   48   end
   49 
   50   def makeSlideSprite(spriteName, deltaMult, appearTime, origin = nil)
   51     # If deltaMult is positive, the sprite starts off to the right and moves
   52     # left (for sprites on the player's side and the background).
   53     return if !@sprites[spriteName]
   54     s = addSprite(@sprites[spriteName], origin)
   55     s.setDelta(0, (Graphics.width * deltaMult).floor, 0)
   56     s.moveDelta(0, appearTime, (-Graphics.width * deltaMult).floor, 0)
   57   end
   58 end

   60 #===============================================================================
   61 # Shows wild Pokémon fading back to their normal color, and triggers their intro
   62 # animations
   63 #===============================================================================
   64 class Battle::Scene::Animation::Intro2 < Battle::Scene::Animation
   65   def initialize(sprites, viewport, sideSize)
   66     @sideSize = sideSize
   67     super(sprites, viewport)
   68   end
   69 
   70   def createProcesses
   71     @sideSize.times do |i|
   72       idxBattler = (2 * i) + 1
   73       next if !@sprites["pokemon_#{idxBattler}"]
   74       battler = addSprite(@sprites["pokemon_#{idxBattler}"], PictureOrigin::BOTTOM)
   75       battler.moveTone(0, 4, Tone.new(0, 0, 0, 0))
   76       battler.setCallback(10 * i, [@sprites["pokemon_#{idxBattler}"], :pbPlayIntroAnimation])
   77     end
   78   end
   79 end
